div.head: VII Atr 7
div.ab: Et reddatur pecunia elemosine hinc ad festum sancti Michaelis, si alicubi retro sit, per plenam witam.
Et reddatur pecunia elemosinae hinc ad festum sancti Michaelis, si alicubi retro sit, per plenam witam.
Et reddatur pecunia elemosinae hinc ad festum sancti Michaelis, si alicubi retro sit, per plenam witam.
And alms-money, if it is in arrears, shall be paid between now and Michaelmas, under pain of incurring the full penalty.
And if anyone is behind in his almsgiving, let it be paid between now and the Feast of Saint Michael, or the full penalty shall be assessed.
Und Almosengeld, wenn es irgendwo rückständig ist, zahle man von jetzt bis zum Michaelisfest [29. Sept.], bei vollem Strafgelde.
And let alms-money, if it is in arrears anywhere, be paid from now until Michaelmas [29 September], on pain of the full fine.
